sources.title: GitHub - airockchip/rknn-llm
sources.snippet: Description RKLLM software stack can help users to quickly deploy AI models to Rockchip chips. The overall framework is as follows: In order to use RKNPU, users need to first run the RKLLM-Toolkit tool on the computer, convert the trained model into an RKLLM format model, and then inference on the development board using the RKLLM C API.
